description: The Assortments band on a channel without the products, as ReelFlies_CA is until refactor 14 assigns them: the query answers null for every pick, so no card renders and the band hides itself. For render tests and home-assortments-screens only. The storefront query's result is fixture data built from plan/design/src/store-data.json and the product export of 2026-09-07 (names, paths, prices and each product's default photo); probe 13 hasn't run, so no real response is saved yet (docs/widgets.md, "The Assortments band").
